# Novum AI

> Novum AI implements AI in operational businesses with no one whose job is AI: training, agents, custom software, and a fractional Chief AI Officer. We teach your team, build the tools, connect your systems, and you own all of it: the code, the data, the accounts, and the training library are in the client's company name.

Every engagement starts with a paid discovery, sized by company and tools. It maps how the work moves, audits every tool and its cost, writes an AI usage policy, trains the team on its own work, and puts the first build live on the client's own data. After discovery, most clients keep Novum as their fractional Chief AI Officer, one engagement sized in discovery; others choose a one-time project.

Key facts:
- No seats, no per-user licenses, no revenue share.
- Agents work inside the client's systems, see only what each role allows, and a person approves anything before it leaves the company.
- Hosted on SOC 2 Type 2 infrastructure.
- Training is hands-on, on the team's own tools and data, with a recorded library the client keeps.

## Services

- [AI Implementation](https://www.thenovumai.com/ai-implementation): training plus an AI Officer; your team using AI, and the tools built around your data.
- [Fractional Chief AI Officer](https://www.thenovumai.com/ai-officer): every tool connected, unlimited agents and builds worked one or two at a time, team trained every month.
- [AI Training](https://www.thenovumai.com/training): monthly training on your own tools, a library you keep, and a 5-hour on-site training day quoted by team size.
- [How We Work](https://www.thenovumai.com/how-we-work): discovery, build, train, run.

## Evidence and tools

- [How to implement AI in a small business](https://www.thenovumai.com/guides/how-to-implement-ai): a 5-step plan: map the work, set the rules, pick one first build, train the team on its own work, keep it measured.
- [What AI implementation costs](https://www.thenovumai.com/guides/ai-implementation-cost): the six cost lines, what moves the price, hidden costs, and how to compare quotes.
- [Why AI](https://www.thenovumai.com/why-ai): what controlled studies and real companies measured about AI and the time work takes.
- [Results](https://www.thenovumai.com/case-studies): three engagements, measured. A construction company replaced a $100,000-a-year platform with a system it owns. A real estate developer replaced a $60,000-a-year investor platform. A bookkeeping firm cut data entry by 95%.
- [Free AI Readiness Score](https://www.thenovumai.com/assessment): 12 questions, a score out of 100, and an estimate of the hours on the table.
